draft.text: You came because you have been having chest pain when you walk.
The pain feels like pressure in your chest and has been happening for about three months.
You said the pain stops when you stop walking.
You do not have shortness of breath, dizziness, or sweating with the pain.
You have diabetes and may have high blood pressure, but you are not on medication for it.
Your doctor mentioned there may be a family history of heart disease, but you do not know for sure.
You had a normal EKG in the past, but you have not had a stress test or echocardiogram.
You do not have recent results for your lipid profile or troponin tests.
The next steps will be discussed.
